item.summary: fix(skills): report execution-directory skill precedence collisions (#125865) loadMergedWorkspaceSkills dropped execution-directory skills whose name collided with an agent-workspace skill without any log, diagnostic, or record, while the sibling loadSkillEntries merge warned on every collision with winner/loser source and path. An operator's execution-directory skill simply did not exist and nothing said why. Extract the existing warning into warnSkillPrecedenceCollision and call it from both merge paths. Precedence is unchanged: the agent workspace still wins.
